# cloider_bucket (Resource)

An S3 compatible object storage bucket. Access it with a `cloider_bucket_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloider_bucket" "assets" {
  name       = "acme-assets"
  public     = true
  versioning = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The bucket's name, 3 to 63 lower case letters, digits and `-`. Bucket names are shared by every Cloider account, so it has to be one nobody else has. Changing it replaces the bucket.

### Optional

- `public` (Boolean) Whether anyone may read the bucket's files without a key. Defaults to `false`.
- `region` (String) The region code, see `cloider_bucket_regions`. Defaults to the first region. Changing it replaces the bucket.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `versioning` (Boolean) Whether the bucket keeps previous versions of its files. Versioning that was on can only be suspended, so `false` after `true` keeps the versions already kept. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the bucket was created, RFC 3339.
- `endpoint` (String) The S3 endpoint of the bucket's region.
- `id` (String) The bucket's id.
- `status` (String) `Ready`, `Failed` or `Terminating`.
- `url` (String) The bucket's url, where a public bucket's files are read.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A bucket is imported by its id, see `cloider bucket list`
terraform import cloider_bucket.assets b7r2xw
```
